DIAGNOSIS READY: Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma (likely Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma)

The painless, rubbery, and fixed nature of your supraclavicular lymph node, combined with B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss) and significantly elevated LDH, strongly points towards a high-grade malignancy. The normal inflammatory markers and negative autoimmune workup further support a lymphoproliferative disorder over infection or vasculitis.
